subject.title: [Feature]: deterministic context injection for bootstrap files and session-type filtering

question: Which bootstrap context contract should OpenClaw support for session-scoped file selection, dynamic bootstrap execution, and live-time context?
rationale: The remaining work adds public config/default semantics and a security-sensitive command execution boundary, while multiple open PRs already cover narrower overlapping slices.

options.title: Design unified contract first
options.body: Specify session-type selectors, exact-session extras, dynamic command execution limits, and cache/time behavior before landing or reshaping the subset PRs.

options.title: Land static selection only
options.body: Accept a narrower static bootstrap tier or session-selector feature and explicitly defer bootstrap command expansion and live system-prompt time.

options.title: Keep current hardcoded filters
options.body: Reject broader bootstrap config and dynamic execution for now, relying on hooks, session_status, and existing static allowlists.

recommendation.title: Design unified contract first
recommendation.body: Specify session-type selectors, exact-session extras, dynamic command execution limits, and cache/time behavior before landing or reshaping the subset PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to the existing subagent bootstrap filtering history and is the best available owner candidate for the cross-cutting bootstrap/product contract decision.
